definition: One of the three federal economic immigration programmes managed through Express Entry, selecting on skilled work experience and human capital factors such as education and language ability.
longform: It requires at least 1 year of continuous full-time skilled work experience (or the part-time equivalent), a minimum Canadian Language Benchmark of 7 in all four abilities, and a pass mark of 67 points on a separate selection grid, before a candidate is scored under the Comprehensive Ranking System for an invitation.
